# Personas — Clinic Network Booking

Transformation contract:
TC-1 — Details: exactly one register population per charter, resolving to
       a `stakeholders.md` entry.
TC-2 — System-facing activities: capability-level lines (verb + object);
       they are read as candidate role-and-action evidence — nothing
       else in a charter is transformation input.
TC-3 — Namespace: persona names are charter-local human forenames,
       disjoint from role names, register populations, and register
       individuals; a persona name is never used as an actor anywhere.

## Marta — details: Clients

| Field | Content |
|---|---|
| Goals | Book a Specialist's time without phoning the clinic; cancel an Appointment without calling `[presale brief · kickoff notes]` |
| Behaviors & environment | Books by phone today; an unanswered call ends the attempt and the booking is simply lost `[kickoff notes]` |
| Frustrations | Calls to the clinic go unanswered → P-1 `[canvas: Problems P-1]` |
| System-facing activities | Browse a Specialist's published Availability · Book an available Slot · Cancel own Appointment `[canvas: Core Functions]` |
| Source | register: Clients · presale brief · kickoff notes · canvas P-1 |
